data.gender_notes: Arockia is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arockia is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Arohkah' which means 'shining light'. This name is often given to babies born under auspicious circumstances, symbolizing their innate ability to light up the lives of those around them. The name Arockia carries the meaning “Shining Light” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Arockia usually hope their child will grow to embody shining light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
